evidence_sentence: The Strait of Hormuz has been effectively closed since March 4 2026 threatening energy and critical material supply lines that underpin Taiwan semiconductor manufacturing. Helium prices have doubled disrupting a critical material used in advanced chip manufacturing.
analytical_interpretation: 供應鏈風險達到最高嚴重度：台灣LNG僅剩11天庫存，氦氣價格翻倍直接衝擊先進製程產能。
recommended_follow_up_zh: 請立即確認台積電與台灣政府的能源緊急備援計畫，以及氦氣替代供應商狀況。

evidence_sentence: The US government plans tariff exemptions for TSMC tied to $165 billion US investment commitment. Taiwan reciprocal tariff rate set at no more than 15%, while Chinese semiconductor imports face 50% tariff effective January 2026.
analytical_interpretation: 關稅政策重塑全球半導體供應鏈：台灣廠商享有15%優惠稅率，中國廠商面對50%關稅，競爭格局顯著改變。
recommended_follow_up_zh: 請詢問客戶如何評估關稅情境對成本結構的衝擊，並確認是否已建立關稅情境模型。

evidence_sentence: TSMC has alerted key clients including NVIDIA and Broadcom that capacity at its most advanced chipmaking nodes is becoming increasingly limited as AI chip demand surges 45% year-over-year.
analytical_interpretation: 客戶集中度風險加劇：NVIDIA與Broadcom高度依賴台積電先進製程，產能受限可能影響AI加速器交期與客戶訂單穩定性。
recommended_follow_up_zh: 請確認前三大客戶占台積電先進製程產能比例，以及訂單取消或延遲條款。

evidence_sentence: Taiwan imports 97% of its energy with LNG reserves lasting only 11 days without foreign imports. Energy risks put TSMC and global AI chip supply in focus as the Strait of Hormuz closure threatens the supply lines.
analytical_interpretation: 能源風險已升至董事會層級議題：台灣高度依賴進口能源，地緣政治衝突導致能源安全成為半導體供應鏈的核心風險。
recommended_follow_up_zh: 請詢問台積電的能源多元化計畫、再生能源採購比例與緊急備援電力機制。

evidence_sentence: Trump administration announces new tariffs on Chinese chips and electronic components. Chinese semiconductor imports already face 50% tax effective January 2026. China responded with export controls on rare earths including gallium, germanium, and graphite.
analytical_interpretation: 雙邊監管風險：美國對中國晶片徵收50%關稅，中國反制限制稀土出口，台灣廠商需同時管理兩側政策風險。
recommended_follow_up_zh: 請確認客戶供應鏈中稀土材料（鎵、鍺、石墨）的替代來源與庫存水位。

evidence_sentence: TSMC Arizona fab production costs are approximately 30% higher than equivalent Taiwan production, compressing margins on US-mandated manufacturing. TSMC raised dividend 28% despite this cost differential, supported by 38% revenue growth.
analytical_interpretation: 美國建廠成本溢價30%壓縮利潤率，但AI需求驅動的38%營收成長提供緩衝。需持續監控成本結構是否能被定價能力吸收。
recommended_follow_up_zh: 請詢問客戶如何在美國投資義務與成本競爭力之間取得平衡，以及定價策略調整空間。

evidence_sentence: AI server manufacturers face inventory planning challenges because demand is strong but order timing from hyperscale cloud customers can shift quickly. US-China tariff uncertainty (30% total on Chinese goods, suspended until November 2026) adds planning complexity.
analytical_interpretation: 關稅不確定性增加庫存規劃難度：客戶訂單時序受政策影響可能快速改變，增加備料過多或過少的風險。
recommended_follow_up_zh: 請追問庫存天數目標值、需求預測準確率，以及關稅情境下的安全庫存策略。

evidence_sentence: As Taiwan semiconductor factories connect more equipment and production data for AI server manufacturing, cybersecurity monitoring and operational technology resilience requirements are increasing. Connected factory OT/IT integration creates new attack surfaces.
analytical_interpretation: 智慧製造與AI server擴產提高OT/IT整合需求，也增加網路攻擊面與生產連續性風險。
recommended_follow_up_zh: 請確認OT/IT資安監控架構、事件通報流程與關鍵設備備援機制。
